high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from Inc42.com, a business news website. The article discusses Meesho's funding round, which is reported to be $300 million. The content highlights the significance of this funding round, noting that it is rare in the current funding climate. It mentions that this round signifies Tiger Global's return to investing in India and marks the investor's first major round since Scott Shleifer, head of private equity, stepped down in November last year.
